justification: When a lookup check failed, the rules page showed no condition, precinct or council rules, which reads as "none apply". It now lists each unchecked item with what failed, why (no reply, busy, error) and where to check it; a failed precinct lookup is recorded instead of returning "no precinct"; a failed council lookup no longer shows "council not covered".

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: server lookup library plus the rules panel client component on the assessment page
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: conditionsNotChecked
functions.input: property constraints with the not-checked list, reasons and condition facts
functions.output: list of what, why and where for each condition whose check did not answer
functions.if_none: null constraints give an empty list; missing reasons say did not answer

functions.name: getPrecinctForAddress
functions.input: address, LGA, coordinates, heritage name and an option to throw on error
functions.output: the matched precinct, null for no match, or a thrown error when asked
functions.if_none: other callers keep the old null on error; the property path now throws and records not checked

break_it.scenario: the NSW flood map times out during a busy period for a flood lot
break_it.what_happens: no flood rules show and the user reads no flood rules apply
break_it.repro: mock the flood fetch to abort
break_it.how: notice lists Flood with did not reply in time and a link

break_it.scenario: the precinct database errors for a property inside a precinct area
break_it.what_happens: precinct rules vanish and the page implies no precinct
break_it.how: property path throws, records precinct not checked, notice lists it

break_it.scenario: the planning lookup fails so no council is known for the address
break_it.what_happens: page showed the not-covered interest form for a covered council
break_it.repro: constraints with planning_layers in notChecked and no former council
break_it.how: page shows Council rules not checked with a link

break_it.scenario: the NSW server rate-limits with a 429 during a rush of lookups
break_it.what_happens: busy could be shown as a generic failure or not at all
break_it.how: reason recorded as busy and shown in words

break_it.scenario: other routes still call the precinct lookup without the new option
break_it.what_happens: they would start throwing and break if the default changed
break_it.how: throwOnError defaults to false; only the property path opts in

post_merge.manual_verify: open /assessment for an address while forcing a lookup failure in the preview and read the notice

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a failed check produces no notice, a busy server reads as a fact, the precinct lookup swallows a DB error, or the page drops the notice
falsifiable_check.observed_red: origin/main: getPrecinctForAddress catches every DB error and returns null; the page shows the council-interest form when the lookup failed
